headline: Wall Street ticks higher as SpaceX and AI stocks lift markets
summary: U.S. and global stock markets ticked higher as strong profit reports from SpaceX and optimism around artificial intelligence stocks boosted investor sentiment.
why: Major equity indices like the S&P 500 and Nasdaq track broader market sentiment driven by technology earnings and macroeconomic trends, serving as key gauges of economic health for investors.
